title: From workflow to review evidence
alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  06 VERIFY LIFECYCLE From workflow to review evidence A record of selected evidence, retained for authorized review. 01 Workflow An AI-assisted step occurs. CUSTOMER 02 Capture Select and supply context. CUSTOMER 03 Retain Hold the submitted record. OBLIGRA 04 Retrieve Find it by business context. OBLIGRA 05 Verify Check the record’s integrity. OBLIGRA 06 Evidence Use it in a review workflow. CUSTOMER REVIEW Verification checks the retained artifact. It does not establish that the decision was right. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
editorial_note: Six lifecycle stages preserved. Evidence is shown being used by customer reviewers rather than implying a guaranteed compliance result.
